_comment: Expectation manifest for this skill's frozen acceptance-checks.
Enforced repo-wide by scripts/evals-all.mjs on every push and PR.
expect "green" = a past fix that must not regress. MUST exit 0.
expect "red"   = a known-failing check (open concern). MUST exit 0 or 1.
A check file missing from this manifest FAILS the gate: an unlisted check is unguarded.
No acceptance-checks yet -- this skill has a FLOOR only. The floor is the always-on fence;
a check is added the first time a concern about this skill is turned into a RED-on-baseline
